answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 20995 Country: India Title: Where should be the eyes directed during ruku saying atahayyat and sajda? Question: Where should be the eyes directed during ruku saying atahayyat and sajda? Answer ID: 20995 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 542/L=181/tl=1431) The eyes should be directed during ruku on feet, in sajdah on nose and in tashahhud at lap. و إلى ظهر قدميه حال ركوعه و إلى أرنبة أنفه حال سجوده و إلى حجره حال قعوده (الدر المختار مع الشامى: 2/175 باب صفة الصلاة). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
